name: Ranger Pathfinder cuts Adrenaline Rush's cooldown by 90% only while Elude is active (#1874)
contract: Pathfinder 706284 (Ranger Archery talent, CharacterAdvancement 31281, SpellFamilyName 27, SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) reads 'Your Adrenaline Rush now incurs a $s1% reduced cooldown when used while Elude is active.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 3 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, BasePoints -91 + DieSides 1 = -90, masked to family 27 word 0 0x20000. The only family-27 record carrying that flag is the hidden Elude SLS3 524969, whose effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, value 0, masked to family 27 word 1 0x20 = Adrenaline Rush 520578 (RecoveryTime 90000). So with the talent SLS3's effect 0 reads -90 and, while SLS3 is on the Ranger, Adrenaline Rush's 90 sec cooldown becomes 9 sec. Nothing put SLS3 on the Ranger: AscensionClassMechanics applies Elude SLS 524862 and SLS2 524886 with Elude 801345 but not SLS3, so the talent never acted. Expected: SLS3 follows the Elude aura; without the talent it reads 0 and Adrenaline Rush keeps 90 sec even in Elude; with the talent but outside Elude the cooldown stays 90 sec; with the talent in Elude it is 9 sec. Adrenaline Rush carries SPELL_ATTR1_ALLOW_WHILE_STEALTHED, so casting it keeps Elude. Before the fix the SLS3 presence assertion and the 9 sec cooldown assertion fail.

steps.label: SETUP: the Ranger is in Elude
Elude carries its hidden SLS3 companion
Without Pathfinder the companion's cooldown modifier is zero
Adrenaline Rush in Elude without Pathfinder
Control: without Pathfinder Adrenaline Rush keeps its 90 sec cooldown in Elude
Adrenaline Rush does not break Elude
SETUP: Pathfinder is active on the Ranger
Adrenaline Rush with Pathfinder outside Elude
Control: outside Elude Pathfinder leaves the 90 sec cooldown
SETUP: the Ranger is in Elude again
Pathfinder makes the companion a 90% cooldown reduction
Adrenaline Rush with Pathfinder in Elude
DISCRIMINATING: in Elude Pathfinder cuts the cooldown to 9 sec
